content: The Policy is applicable to all employees i.e., full term employee, fixed term employee, or contract term employee (FTE, CT) on roll of HCL Technologies Limited and its subsidiaries, affiliates Companies (“HCLTech”) having operations in various locations & facilities across India.
Each pause is a step towards sustained productivity.

We understand that leaves are an essential part of the work fabric allowing our employees the convenience to take care of personal exigencies as well as to meet their social obligations. Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, the Company offers adequate leave opportunities empowering the employees to recharge, rejuvenate, and return with renewed vigor.
Leave Entitlements at a Glance
A summary of all leave categories along with corresponding entitlement is listed below:
For more information regarding any leave, refer to the specific leave category sections.

An employee can avail annual leave to meet any medical/personal emergencies as well as for any Vaccation . ALs get accumulated every month and employees can take ALs up to a maximum of the accumulated balance. Annual leave can be availed in units of half day as well.
Note - Freshers who are undergoing training are allowed to avail one leave per month, subject to approval from their Reporting Manager[
Entitlement of Annual Leave
**02 days of additional leave will be credited in respective employee’s leave records in the subsequent leave cycle.
Out of 18/20 AL accrual, a maximum of 12 leave (1 AL per month) can be carried forward.
AL entitlement for a new joiner who joins in between the leave accounting year shall be prorated basis the no. of months remaining in that leave accounting year.
Application Process for Annual leave

Annual Leave is required to be applied as per the following timeline, failing which for employees at E6 or below career level, if the Annual leave(s) are not applied as per the rules mentioned above, leave application would go to SLM (Second Level Manager) for approval
For short-term Annual Leave (i.e. <=3 days leaves) - Apply at least 7 days in advance to leave start date.
For long-term Annual Leave (i.e. >3 days leaves) - Apply at least 4 weeks in advance to the leave start date
The leave must be approved by the Reporting Manager before the employee proceeds on leave
If an employee wants to cancel an approved leave, they must inform their Reporting Manager

Notwithstanding anything above, if an employee is unable to report to work due to sudden sickness, he/she would be required to notify his Reporting Manager before the commencement of normal business hours.

Separation from the Company

Employees are not allowed to avail any leave (AL/ transfer leave/ LWP), during the notice period except in case of medical and personal exigencies. The notice period, in such cases, will accordingly be increased by that many days; however, this will not be applicable for Company holidays, My Leave and RHs.
Encashment rules at the time of separation will be as below:
Voluntary Leave Encashment Policy ( VLE)
Guidelines
Annual Window: From February 1st to December 15th of every year.
Request Submission: Request must be submitted latest by 18th day of proceeding month for getting encashment along with payroll of the same month, else will be disbursed in subsequent month.

Eligibility: Employees in bands E0-E3 will have the option to submit VLE Requests. Such request can be made against their available opening balance, including HR adjustments, if any, after adjusting leave taken/applied for till the date of request.
Encashment Rate (E0 to E2 Band): Encashment will be @ wage definition i.e. max of Included or 50% of Remuneration, whichever is higher. . Backdated salary changes will not be considered.
Encashment Rate (E3 Band): Encashment will be at 100% of the employee's basic salary as of the payroll run date. Backdated salary changes will not be considered.
Irreversibility: Employees must assess their future leave requirements before making request for encashment. Once request raised and processed, leave balances cannot be restored.

Cancellation and Changes: Requests can be cancelled before the cut-off date but cannot be edited. If changes are needed, the request must be cancelled, and a new one would be placed before the cut-off date. No cancellation / changes are permitted after the cut-off date
Onsite Employees: Onsite employees of (E0-E3) bands having India leave balance can also encash their Indian accrued leave at the last drawn India wages
Consent: The submission of a request for VLE constitutes the employee’s sole decision and shall be deemed as their consent for processing the request accordingly.
Tax Implications: All encashments under the program will be taxable.
Reference: For detailed guidance, please consult the "Annexure" section of the Policy for "VLE Guide".
An employee can avail these leave for celebrating personal, family occasions e.g. Anniversary, Birthday(s), family function(s), CSR activities and bereavement etc.
Entitlement of My Leave
My leave credit will be prorated based on the employee’s joining date.

**1 day of additional My leave will be credited in employee’s leave records in the subsequent leave cycle. For example: An employee has completed 3 years with HCL Tech on May 15, 2024. Additional My leave of 1 day will be credited in January, 2025.
The leave must be approved by the Reporting Manager before the employee proceeds on leave in a calendar year.
The leave lapse at the end of the year and will not be carried forward. My leave cannot be encashed at any time.
My leave credit will be prorated based on the employee’s joining date.
HCLTech aims to provide an equal and inclusive environment to our women employees, with a maternity leave entitlement as per law allowing them balance motherhood with flourishing careers.
Entitlement of Maternity Leave

Women employees are entitled to further avail one month of paid extended maternity leave after completion of Maternity leave in case of illness arising out of pregnancy/delivery, premature birth of a child etc.
Application Process for Maternity Leave
Women employees are eligible to take breaks to visit the child in the crèche.

In case of miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy (MTP), an employee is entitled to leave with pay upon submission of a medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner to HR. Miscarriage refers to the expulsion of uterine contents before or during the 26th week of pregnancy. Approval from RM and HR is required for availing this leave.
Medical Termination of Pregnancy is governed by the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971, allowing termination in cases where :-
Continuing the pregnancy would endanger the woman's life or cause grave injury to her physical or mental health.
There's a substantial risk of the child being born with serious physical or mental abnormalities.
Pregnancy resulted from an unfortunate act causing grave injury to the woman's mental health.
Within twenty weeks of pregnancy, certification from one medical practitioner is required.
Between twenty to twenty four weeks, certification from two registered medical practitioners is required.
A medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner has to be submitted to the HR and is required to be uploaded while applying for leave in LMS.
This can be availed on approval of RM and HR.
Maternity Leave Extension should be taken in continuation only.

In case of tubectomy operation, the employee is entitled to paid leave for the period of two weeks immediately following the day of her tubectomy operation. Proof issued by a registered medical practitioner is necessary. This can be availed on approval from RM and HR.
Entitlement
Entitlement of Surrogacy Leave
Surrogacy is an arrangement whereby another woman agrees to carry the pregnancy for intended parents who cannot give birth to a baby.
A commissioning mother is eligible for 26 weeks of continuous leave.
Relevant medical documentation must be provided by the commissioning mother to declare having a child through surrogacy.
Eligibility criteria for surrogacy leave is goverened by The surrogacy (Regulation) Act 2021:
The commissioning couple must be Indian citizens and legally married for a minimum of 5 years.
The age group of the commissioning couple must be between 23-50 for females and 26-55 for males.
The commissioning couple must not have any surviving child biologically or through adoption or surrogacy, except in cases of physical or terminal illness of a child born through surrogacy.
The surrogate mother should be a close relative of the commissioning couple and must be between the ages of 25-35 years.
Proof of childbirth, doctor's certificate, or surrogacy documents must be submitted before availing the leave.
After completing necessary legal formalities, an employee opting for surrogacy will be entitled to include the child as a dependent under relevant Company policies.
Maternity benefit granted for adoption other than surrogacy is referred to as adoption leave in this policy.
Entitlement of Adoption Leave:
In case of adoption, employee will be entitled to continuous paid leave, if they are the primary caregiver. These leave durations apply for taking care of stepchildren as well.
Adoption of a child must be through licensed agencies. To avail benefits, the employee must submit a copy of the registered adoption deed and/or proof of childbirth before taking leave.

If documents are unavailable, the employee can provide a written declaration in LMS, committing to submit the necessary documents later. Failure to do so will result in adjustment of the adoption leave from the employee's leave balance.
Legally adopted children, following due procedures, can be included as dependents under relevant Company policies.
Entitlement of Paternity Leave
Application Process for Paternity leave
This leave can be availed for taking care of Surrogate child as well.
In the unfortunate event of demise of mother at the time of childbirth, the father will be entitled to take 26 weeks of continuous paid leave to take care of the Child.

Please Note: Any weekly off or Company Holiday that falls during Maternity leave, Maternity Leave extension, leave for Tubectomy Operation, Adoption leave and Surrogacy leave is counted as part of the respective leave period and will not give rise to any additional leave or payment.
This leave is intended to provide time off from work to support the well‑being of a female employee experiencing menstrual discomfort or related medical symptoms.
Entitlement of Self Care Leave
Given the nature of the leave, no formal approval is required; however, prior coordination with the Reporting Manager is encouraged to avoid any business disruption.
No documentation or justification is needed, though a simple intimation of the absence must be shared with the Reporting Manager.
This leave is non‑accumulative, non‑carry‑forwardable and lapses at the end of the calendar month, and not eligible for encashment.
Female employees marked as absconded, or already on long leave viz. maternity etc. shall not be eligible for this leave.
Application Process for Self-care leave
This leave should be applied either one day in advance or within three working days of availing it.

Women employees who are enrolled/covered under ESIC are required to avail the maternity benefit provided by the government. Employee needs to fill up and submit Form -17 & 19 as per ESIC guidelines to avail themselves of this benefit.
For detailed guidance on ESI act and to download relevant forms, please refer “Annexure” section of the Policy.
COMPENSATORY OFF POLICY FOR WEEKEND/CH WORKING (Employees upto E3 band)
Employees up to E3 Band who are required to work on their scheduled week off or company holiday (not national holiday) can request compensatory off for the days worked.
Request Process
Weekend working should be planned and approved by the Reporting Manager (RM) at least five days in advance.
Compensatory Off requests must be submitted in the Leave Management System (LMS).
Compensatory Off cannot be availed in advance of the extra day planned. It can only be taken after the employee has worked on the extra day.
Validity and Accumulation

Compensatory Offs must be availed within 30 days of accruing. Failure to do so will result in lapse, subject to RM approval. In critical business situations, approval from Second Level Manager (SLM) can extend the period to 60 days.
Employees can accumulate up to a maximum of 2 days of Comp Off in a month. Total accumulation should not exceed 4 days at any given time.
Recruitment Drives Participation
Employees up to E3 Band participating in recruitment drives can choose between availing a recruitment allowance or Compensatory Off, but not both.
Specific Cases

If 2 comp off are in kitty and worked on 3rd week off and time sheet also approved against the same date on 15th of month and later on 17th applied for one comp off, data approved on 15th should be added in account after 17th or not. If not availed 2 comp off and worked again on week off, system will not add 3rd comp off.

Employees are entitled to 5 days of transfer leave (calendar days) to be used between their last working day at the present location and their first working day at the new transferred location, applicable for transfers within India and for employees returning to India from an onsite assignment (9 months or more).
Transfer leave cannot be carried forward or combined with any other type of leave.
If the transfer action is completed in SAP, the employee can apply for Transfer Leave within 1 month from the effective date of Transfer.
If the transfer action is not completed in SAP, the employee can apply and avail for Transfer Leave within 1 month of the transfer leave applying date and the current date.
Employees voluntarily seeking transfer (request transfer) will not be entitled to transfer leave.
Detailed information on transfer is provided in the Transfer Policy.
The Company discourages Leave Without Pay (LWP) except in exceptional circumstances or emergencies, such as serious illness, upon approval.

LWP may only be granted when all other forms of leave are exhausted, with weekends and holidays counted as part of the leave.Example:If an employee goes for Leave without Pay from 20th January (Tuesday) to 28th January (Wednesday), he/she will not receive pay for 26th January too, which was a holiday, and the number of leave days will be considered as 9 days.
RM is the first level approver, and SLM (Minimum E4) is the second level approver for all LWP requests, subject to business situation and management's decision.
LWP requests are submitted to the PIM upon employee submission, with consolidated requests flowing into SAP on the 18th of each month. Rejected requests can be reversed in the next payroll cycle.
Accrual of annual leave in the following year will be proportionately deducted for days on LWP in the previous year.
Failure to report to work after sanctioned LWP may result in disciplinary action, deemed as service abandonment.
Approval authority for LWP:
RM as the first level approver.
SLM (Minimum E4) as the second level approver.
Future dated LWP will be approved after 3 working days from the leave start date at each level.

Intervening holidays/weekends will not be taken into account for leave calculation except in case of child raising leave (except PL) and leave-without-pay. E.g.: If an employee has applied for Annual Leave from 30 June (Friday) to 5th July (Wednesday), then the number of leave calculated is 4 days.
Annual Leave/Child raising Leave/ My Leave can be clubbed with Leave without Pay/Company Holidays/ Restricted Holidays.
No leaves can be clubbed with Compensatory off except for company holidays.

Any absence from duty must be authorized. If an employee is absent from duty without authorization, such absence will be treated as unauthorized absence and may result in disciplinary action as per the Disciplinary Policy - Global. In such cases, the employee is not entitled to salary for that period and will not be able to apply for any other type of leave except for unauthorized absence which is permitted by RM and HR. Furthermore, the HR and RM can apply for this leave on behalf of employees absent from duty and only the HR and RM can cancel this leave.
General Leave Application
Each employee must seek approval for all types of leave from their reporting manager (RM) or Second Level Manager (SLM).
Leave requests will be visible to the SLM for approval even if logged in through the RM role to ensure appropriate action in the absence of the RM.
Employees can apply for 60 days backdated leave in LMS and in case of any leave for medical reasons and beyond 60 days will be applied through SSD.
Auto - Approval
If a backdated AL is applied then the leave will be auto approved after 3 working days from the date of leave submitted.
Future dated AL applied 3 working days prior the leave start date, will be auto approved once it is at least 3 working days pending with the RM.
Leave Without Pay (LWP) Approval
LWP applications will be sent to the RM for approval upon submission through LMS.
Reminders will be sent to the RM and SLM for 3 working days from the leave start date, stating that the request will be auto-approved if no action is taken within that time frame.

(For example, if a leave is applied on November 11 for the period of Dec 1 to Dec 10, a reminder will be sent from Dec 1st till Dec 3rd i.e. 3 working days to the RM (first level approver) for action. If RM doesn't approves/rejects the request within 3 working days, it will get auto approved at first level and flow to the Second Level Manager for approval. If SLM doesn't approves/rejects the request within 3 working days, the request will get auto approved.)

For back dated leave requests, action needs to be taken within 3 working days of leave applied date and reminders will be sent to the RM till 3 working days and to the SLM for further 3 working days clearly stating that request will be auto approved after 3 working days, if no action is taken within those 3 working days.

(For example, if leave is applied on December 11th for the period of Dec 1st to Dec 10th, a reminder will be sent from Dec 12th till 3 working days to RM (first level approver) for action. If RM doesn't approves/rejects the request within 3 working days, it will get auto approved at first level and flow to the Second Level Manager for approval. If SLM doesn't approves/rejects the request within 3 working days, the request will get auto approved.)
Holiday Policy
The holiday year runs from January 1st to December 31st, with holiday announcements for the next calendar year made in late December.
Access the holiday calendar for the year through myhcl.com.
Employees are entitled to Company Holidays and Restricted Holidays.
Company Holidays include fixed national and location-specific holidays, including Jan 26, Aug 15, and Oct 2.
No additional holidays are granted in lieu of mandatory holidays falling on weekends.
In addition to Company Holidays, employees have 4/3 days of Restricted Holidays, credited at the beginning of the year and chosen by the employee.
New joiners receive Restricted Holidays on a pro-rata basis.
Approval for Restricted Holidays is required from the Reporting Manager, with applications to be submitted at least 3 working days in advance through LMS.
Cancellation of applied Restricted Holidays must be done through LMS and approved by the Reporting Manager.
(No weekend allowance eligibility will be applicable on days where double wages are applicable.)
Taking leave without prior approval renders an employee absent without permission, potentially leading to disciplinary action.
Intentional misrepresentation of leave reasons constitutes misconduct, with the Company reserving the right to initiate disciplinary proceedings.
Failure to return or communicate with HR and the Reporting Manager after leave expiration will be treated as unauthorized absence, subjecting the employee to disciplinary action.

Revision History:
1. Are there any entitlements for childcare of stepchildren?
The leave entitlement will be the same as for adoption.
2. Is this policy applicable for all employees in India or some specific policies are also in place?
There are specific policies available for DFS & DPO service lines. Employees from such business service line are eligible for leave as per this specific policy only.
3. Can the employee avail paternity leave in the event of miscarriage/still born during child birth?
Yes, employee can avail paternity leave in this scenario.
4. Does the Paternity leave entitlement stay 5 days even in case of twins/ triplets/ multiple births? Yes. The entitlement will be 5 days only.
5. Which location's RH is applicable to me when I am deputed to a different location? The RH of the parent location will be applicable to an employee who has been deputed to a different location.
6. Can Paternity Leave be taken in breaks? No, Paternity Leave cannot be availed in breaks; it must be availed for 5 working days at a stretch and within 1 year of childbirth.

7. What happens when I get transferred to a different domestic location? Your leave calculation is unchanged when you get transferred to any domestic location. Additionally, you are also entitled to 5 working days of Transfer Leave. For details, please refer to the "Transfer Policy" in Policies Hub.

8. What will be the treatment for Employees who are on Annual Leave ending on or after 1st Dec'16 and not applied for Infant care thereafter (In continuation to ML/MLE)? Employee will not be entitled to additional leave as per the new Policy.

9. What are the repercussions in case of Leave without Pay (LWP). If any employee is marked LWP for a given day(s), his salary for that day(s) will be deducted in that month including statutory and annual benefits like PF, Performance Bonus, LTA and any flexi basket reimbursement. While LWPs will not have direct impact on Annual components, however, when such payments become due - any LWP (s) will have prorated impact on such components. E.g. Performance Bonus etc., as mentioned above.

10. Can I avail my leave towards any illness? HCL has its unique Leave Policy wherein all the leave are credited in the beginning of the year and all casual, earned and sick leave are merged into one leave type called Annual Leave. Employees have the option to avail any of them under one leave type. Few unused leave are encashed at the year end and remaining gets carried forward for future use and un availed leave will be encashed at the time of separation.

11. I am in E4 and above band, I have leave accrual from previous year's balance in my account, and 20 leaves have been credited in current year start. I have availed few leave, which leave will be encashed and carried forward? Kindly refer to the following examples for clarifications: Ex. 1: 45 leaves (previous year's balance) + 20 leaves (current year's credit) = 65 leave. Out of new balance of 20 leaves: 6 leaves have been availed (which get utilized from encashment bucket) and 2 leave will be encashed. Now as per Policy as maximum accrual can be 45 leaves and hence 12 leaves of current year's balance will be lapse. balance will be 45 leaves at the end of year. Calculation: 45 + 20 = 65, 20(8+12): 8-6=2 encashed. 12 leaves cannot be added to 45 hence will be lapsed. Ex. 2: 30 leave (previous year's balance) + 20 leave (current year's credit) = 65 leaves. Out of new balance of 20 leaves: 9 leaves have been availed (which get utilized from encashment (8-8) + Carry forwardable bucket (12-1)) and remaining 11 leave will be added back to opening balance and closing balance would be 41 leave.

12. One national holiday (2nd October) is falling on weekend. Will there be any compensatory off/ additional holiday given in lieu of above? While finalizing our grid we also looked at this aspect and have tried to create a balance on the number of Company and restricted holidays that can be made available to our employees. As per the Policy adopted from last year, Jan 26, Aug 15, Oct 2 will remain as mandatory holidays irrespective of the days that they fall under. Hence no additional holiday is being provided in case of any mandatory Company holiday falling on a weekend.

13. If I have exhausted my maternity leave and maternity leave extension as on 30th November 2016 and have not applied for Infant care leave, will I get any additional leave as per change in Policy? No. Only if you are on ML, ML extension, Infant Care Leave (ICL) as on 1st December, you will get the additional maternity leave.

14. When will my leave encashment be paid to me? Leave encashment process is done each year in the month of January. The processing will be done only for those employees who are active in the India payroll in the month of Jan.
15. Can paternity leave be taken by the father to take care of surrogate mother? Yes

16. Can I extend my maternity leave beyond 26 weeks? A women employee is entitled to further avail one month of paid extended maternity leave after completion of Maternity leave in case of illness arising out of pregnancy / delivery, premature birth of a child etc. Beyond this one month of extension, it would be leave without pay.
17. Can I avail the 26-week Maternity leave for more than 2 children? Yes, you can. There is no restriction on number of children.

18. How is My Leave proration done for new joiners? Employees joining between 1st January to 30th June will be entitled to 1 My leave and employees joining on/ after 1st July will be entitled to 0.5 My leave.
19. Any prorated leave accrued on the completion of 3 years in the same leave cycle? No

20. What happens to my leave balance when I move onsite for short term (but am still on Indian payroll)? You are not entitled to leave when you are onsite for short term on B-visa. However, your leave will accrue for the period spent onsite also. You will be entitled to avail these leave once you return to India.

21. When will the additional 02 days of leave be credited on completion of three years in the organization? 02 days of additional leave will be credited in respective employee's leave records in the subsequent Leave cycle

22. Will the deducted component be re credited on Leave without pay reversal? LWP reversal process will happen during the payroll cycle of the subsequent month and once the LWP reversal request is approved, the deducted component will be reversed and paid to the employee.

23. What is the leave period applicable to the commissioning parents of the child born through surrogacy? The child raising leave for the intended parents of the child born through surrogacy is 26 weeks

24. Is utilization from cashable bucket first and then from carry forwardable bucket introduced recently? No, this has been the practice since the launch of Leave Policy of India and is applicable to all bands. We encourage employees to utilize their leave for a better work life balance and to avoid lapsing of leave.

25. I am in the E4 and above band, I have leave accrual from previous year's balance in my account, and 20 leaves have been credited in current year start. I have not availed any leave, which leave will be encashed and carried forward? Kindly refer to the following examples for clarifications: Ex. 1: 45 leaves (previous year's balance) + 20 leaves (Current Years Credit) = 65 leaves. Out of new balance of 20 leaves: 8 (encashment) and 12 (will be carry forward) Total will be 45 + 12 =57 leave. Now as per Policy, as maximum accrual can be 45 leave and hence 12 leave will be lapse out of 57, balance will be 45 leaves at the end of year. Ex. 2: 30 leaves (previous year's balance) + 20 leaves (current year's credit) = 50 leaves. Out of new balance of 20 leaves: 8 (encashment) and 12 (will be carry forward), Total will be 30 +12 = 42 leaves. Now, balance will remain 42 leave at the end of year. Ex. 3: 35 leaves (previous year's balance) + 20 leaves (current year's credit) = 55 leaves. Out of new balance of 20 leaves: 8 (encashment) and 12 (will be carry forward). Total will be 35 +12 = 47 leaves. Now, as maximum accrual can be 45 leaves and hence 2 leaves will be lapse out of 47, balance will be 45 leaves at the end of year. Ex. 4: 45 leaves (previous year's balance) + 20 leaves (current year's credit) = 65 leaves. Out of new balance of 20 leave: 12 leave have been availed (8 will get utilized from encashment & 4 from carry forward bucket) and remaining 8 leaves of carry forward bucket will be lapsed. Now as per Policy as maximum accrual can be 45 leaves and hence 8 leaves of current year's balance will be lapse, balance will be 45 leaves at the end of year. Ex. 5: In case of separation from organization there is no upper limit applicable, hence all the carry forward leave will be paid along with F&F

26. I am in E4 and above band, I have leave accrual from previous year's balance in my account, and 18 leaves have been credited in current year start. Which leave will be encashed and carried forward in case I avail few leave or not avail any? Kindly refer to the following examples for clarifications: Ex. 1: 5 leaves (previous year's balance) + 18 leaves (current year's credit) = 23 leaves. Out of new balance of 18 leaves: 6 leaves have been availed (which get utilized from encashment bucket) and remaining 12 leave of carry forward bucket will be added to previous balance of 5. Total balance will be 17 leaves at the end of year. Ex. 2: 35 leaves (previous year's balance) + 18 leave (current year's credit) = 53 leaves. Out of new balance of 18 leaves: If no leave are availed, then 6 will be encashed and 12 will be added back to previous balance of 35 which comes to 47 in total. Now as per Policy as maximum accrual can be 45 leaves and hence 2 leaves will be lapse, balance will be 45 leaves at the end of year (35 +10 = 45 leave). Ex. 3: 30 leaves (previous year's balance) + 18 leaves (current year's credit) = 48 leaves. Out of new balance of 18 leaves: 8 leaves have been availed (6 will get utilized from encashment & 2 from carry forward bucket) and remaining 10 leave will be carried forward and will be added to previous balance of 30 leaves, balance will be 40 leaves at the end of year.

27. What will be the AL entitlement for a new joiner who joins in between the leave accounting year? Annual Leave entitlement for a new joiner joining during the leave accounting year shall be prorated basis the no. of months remaining in that leave accounting year.
28. What leave can be availed while on notice period?
While on notice period, an employee cannot avail any leave except RH and My Leave.
29 . What is the maximum leave accumulation limit?
E0 to E3: Maximum 45 days can be carried forward. Any leave beyond 45 days will be encashed.
E4 and above: Maximum 45 days can be carried forward. Any leave beyond 45 days will lapse.
30. What happens if I have more than 45 days at year-end?
E0 to E3: Extra days beyond 45 will be encashed and paid with January salary.
Example: If you have 50 days, 5 days will be encashed, and 45 days will carry forward.
E4 and above: Extra days beyond 45 will lapse.
Example: If you have 50 days, 5 days will lapse, and 45 days will carry forward.
31. How does year-end encashment work for unused leaves?
For both E0–E3 and E4 & above: Unused leaves from the encashment bucket (non-carried forward) will be encashed.
Example: If 8 days are in the encashment bucket and you avail 6, the remaining 2 will be encashed.
32. How is leave handled during a promotion from E2 to E3 and what will be the formula for year end accumulation & encashment?

If an employee is promoted from E2 to E3 in October (after completing 9 months in the E3 band), any extra leaves beyond the 45-day limit will be split proportionately based on the number of months spent in the E2 and E3 bands.

The employee’s annual leave balance on 1 January will thus stand at 45 days. 50 (Total) - 45 (Carry forward) = 5 (Encashment). E3 Band Rule: AL balance of an employee on 31 December is 50 days. (50-45) =5 days will be encashed and paid to the employee along with the January salary. The employee’s annual leave balance on 1 January will thus stand at 45 days. 50 (Total) - 45 (Carry forward) = 5 (Encashment). E4 and above Rule: AL balance of an employee on 31 December is 50 days. (50-45) =5 days will be lapsed. The employee’s annual leave balance on 1 January will thus stand at 45 days. 50 (Total) - 45 (Carry forward) = 5 (Lapse)

Employee band: E3 and Above. Encashment logic at separation: All unutilized accumulated leave, including Annual Leave (AL) accrued up to the Last Working Day (“LWD”), shall be encashed during Full and Final settlement @ 100 % of Basic Salary.
